context: A week after a bad fight. Riku is at the kitchen table; Yumiko sits down across from him. Both have been carrying it.
purpose: long-deferred repair — mother and teen, finally talking

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Pulls the chair out slowly. Voice softer than usual.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: One syllable. Doesn't look up from his phone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: この前、本当にごめんなさい。言いすぎた。
lines.en: The other day — I'm really sorry. I said too much.
lines.style: The apology first, no excuses. Voice steady.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Reflexive teen-deflect. Voice slightly higher than the line.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 別にじゃない。…私、ちゃんと言わなかった。
lines.en: It's not whatever. …I didn't talk to you properly.
lines.style: A small insistent line. Doesn't accept the deflection.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small honest question. Looks up briefly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ずっと、言いたかったの。時間、作れなくて。
lines.en: I've been wanting to. Just couldn't find the time.
lines.style: Voice tired, real. The mom-honesty rare for him to hear.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small honest admission. Quietest line in the scene.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: …ありがとう、それ言ってくれて。
lines.style: A real catch in the voice. Means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お母さんも、大変だしさ。
lines.en: You've got it hard too, you know.
lines.style: A small uncharacteristic empathy. Voice slightly lower.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう。でも、リクが優先。本当に、大切。
lines.en: Thank you. But you come first. Really — you matter.
lines.style: A real direct line. Eye-contact level voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real beat. The whole week resettling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、何か一緒にしよ。ご飯でも、ゲームでも。
lines.en: Let's do something together sometime. Food, games — whatever.
lines.style: A small forward step. Practical kindness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ゲーム、お母さん下手じゃん。
lines.style: A real small grin in the voice. Affection through teasing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: A real laugh. The whole repair complete.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: The smallest assent. Phone finally face-down in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとう、リク。本当に。
lines.style: Closing line. Voice steady — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: The smallest most-important line of the conversation.
